# [CS026] JWT 'none' Algorithm Allowed (jwt-alg-none)

Unsigned JWTs are accepted or created.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | CRITICAL |
| **Category** | Security |
| **CWE** | [CWE-347](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/347.html) |
| **OWASP** | A04:2025 |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

With the none algorithm a token carries no signature, so anyone can forge claims such as the user ID or role.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
token, err := jwt.Parse(raw, keyFunc, jwt.WithValidMethods([]string{"none", "HS256"}))
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
token, err := jwt.Parse(raw, keyFunc, jwt.WithValidMethods([]string{"HS256"}))
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [jwt-alg-none]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    jwt-alg-none: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore jwt-alg-none -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** jwt-alg-none
```
